name: vintage-collage-editorial
label: Vintage collage art + 19th-century editorial typography (serif plates, italic captions)
source: refs/: plates and a frame from the author's own Tulip Mania run
imagePrompt: Vintage hand-engraved collage illustration, 19th-century copperplate etching cut-outs in sepia and grayscale, torn antique map paper fragments, flat forest-green (#24442F) and burnished gold-leaf (#C9A043) circles behind the subject, botanical engravings (tea leaves, camellia, poppies) framing the edges, thin gold orbit lines with small dots and four-point sparkles, warm cream textured paper background, centered composition with empty space at top and bottom, editorial, museum quality, no text, no watermark
elementPrompt: single isolated vintage copperplate engraving cut-out of {subject}, sepia and grayscale etching, crisp paper cut edge, centered, plain pure white background, no shadow, no text
negative: photo realism, neon, 3d render, gradients, glossy, text, letters, logo, watermark, cartoon

motion.headline: word
rules: Every scene is a stack of layers: paper, code-drawn circles, torn map plate, hero cut-out, 2-4 prop cut-outs, orbit ring, sparkles.
Layers enter staggered 4-6 frames apart with a soft spring (damping 18), never all at once.
Constant slow drift: hero scale 1.00->1.04 over the scene, props parallax 6-14 px in opposite directions, circles rotate 2-4 deg.
Orbit ring draws on (stroke-dashoffset) over 20 frames; planets ride the ring.
Sparkles twinkle (scale 0.6-1.1, opacity) on staggered sine phases.
Scene change: outgoing layers drift up 30 px and fade over 8 frames while new circles grow from 0 — no hard cuts, no slides, no zoom-punch.
Headline reveals word by word synced to VO, accent words in green, rest muted; caption pill shows the spoken phrase.
